response.overview: Big Japan Pro-Wrestling returns to the legendary combat sports mecca, Tokyo Korakuen Hall, for an action-packed night headlined by a historic, bloody war for the BJW Deathmatch Heavyweight Championship.In the main event, the iconic wrestling veteran Abdullah Kobayashi challenges the reigning champion Yusaku Ito in a brutal, no-holds-barred title match that pushes both men to their absolute physical limits. The stacked undercard features a chaotic Fluorescent Lighttubes Death Match pitting the international destructive force of Beastman, MASADA, and Mickie Knuckles against the fearless Japanese trio of Kankuro Hoshino, Kazumi Kikuta, and Masaya Takahashi. From high-impact strong-style battles to glass-shattering ultraviolence, this event showcases the very best of BJW's dual identities.
response.title: BJW - July 31st 2026, Kouraken Hall
